name: @meddleware/sui-indexer
description: Lean read-indexer for Meddleware's Sui packages: polls access_gate and sealed_content events over gRPC into SQLite and serves cacheable GET pages.
author: MeddleWare <dev@meddleware.co.uk>

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/main.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
